narrativePost.fullText:
# LinkedIn Authority Post — Staff Handoff & Knowledge Continuity Engine

Most companies lose 15–30% of their revenue not because of bad marketing, but because of silent workflow breakdowns.

We built **Staff Handoff & Knowledge Continuity Engine** to solve this exact problem:
Autonomous SOP and account compilation system that synthesizes an employee’s communication logs, client commitments, and open tasks into a single immutable handover dossier.

### The Sentinel Claim Audit Registry
* **Benchmark Scenario:** Evaluated against synthetic multi-factor telemetry.
* **Demonstrated Latency:** Sub-millisecond calculation in zero-dependency Node.js runtime.
* **Live In-Browser Sandbox:** https://gideonbawa-website.netlify.app/simulators/staff-handoff-engine/
* **Source Code:** https://github.com/bawagideon/staff-handoff-engine

#SoftwareEngineering #B2B #Automation #SystemsEngineering #GideonHQ
